doc.title: Math Class
doc.para:
Math Class It is almost compatible with JavaScript's Math.
Implemented methods: abs (Get absolute value) acos (Arc cosine) asin (Arc sine) atan (Arc tangent) atan2 (Arc tangent of two variables) ceil (Round up) floor (Round down) exp (e to the power of n) log (Natural logarithm) max (The larger of two values) min (The smaller of two values) random (Random number greater than or equal to 0 and less than 1) pow (Power) round (Rounding to an integer) sin (Sine) cos (Cosine) tan (Tangent) sqrt (Square root)
Implemented properties: E (e) LN10 (log(10)) LN2 (log(2)) LOG10E (Base-10 logarithm of e) LOG2E (Base-2 logarithm of e) PI (π) SQRT1_2 (sqrt(1/2)) SQRT2 (sqrt(2))
